title: Shop interiors (our own): the konbini (small, large), the family restaurant and the supermarket, one .blend per store
author: this project
notes: One .blend per store TYPE (Shop_KonbiniS.blend, Shop_KonbiniL.blend, Shop_FamilyRestaurant.blend); each OWNS its interior piece <Id>_Interior. blender/tools/build_shop_blends.py laid them out once from tools/building_kit/shop_interiors.py and keeps a piece an artist has edited.

The shell (outer walls, shopfront, roof, the street entrance) is still the downtown kit's modules, laid by tools/building_kit/layout_buildings.py from building_types.json; the interior piece stands at the footprint centre on the floor.
Materials are the central library's palette: the scene builder resolves every surface to kits/library/materials/<name>.tres (materials_from).
